chiefComplaint: Increased thirst, frequent urination, fatigue for 3 weeks

soap.subjective: Reports excessive thirst, frequent urination (5-6 times at night), unexplained fatigue for 3 weeks. No family history of diabetes. Weight loss of ~3kg in 2 months. No blurred vision.
soap.objective: BMI 27.8. Random blood glucose 248 mg/dL. No dehydration signs. No peripheral neuropathy. Pedal pulses palpable.
soap.assessment: Suspected Type 2 diabetes mellitus. Elevated random blood glucose. Needs confirmatory testing.
soap.plan: Order HbA1c, fasting glucose, renal panel. Start Metformin 500mg BD. Diabetes education and dietary counseling. Follow up in 8 weeks with lab results.

chiefComplaint: Diabetes follow-up — review labs and medication tolerance

soap.subjective: Reports improved symptoms. Less thirst. Nocturia reduced to 1-2 times. Tolerating Metformin well. Occasional mild nausea after meals. No hypoglycemic episodes.
soap.objective: Weight 83kg (down 2kg). Lab results: HbA1c 7.8%, FBS 142 mg/dL. Renal function normal. BP 134/86 mmHg.
soap.assessment: T2DM — improving but HbA1c still above target. Borderline hypertension noted.
soap.plan: Continue Metformin 500mg BD. Add Atorvastatin 10mg for cardiovascular risk reduction. Monitor BP — if persistently elevated, start antihypertensive. Repeat labs in 8 weeks.

chiefComplaint: Routine checkup and elevated blood pressure follow-up

soap.subjective: Feeling well. No chest pain, headaches, or dizziness. Dietary compliance improved. Walking 30 mins daily. Metformin tolerated. No hypoglycemia.
soap.objective: Weight 82.5kg. BP 142/90 mmHg (elevated on repeat). Fundoscopy normal. Foot exam normal.
soap.assessment: T2DM — stable. Essential hypertension confirmed. Starting antihypertensive.
soap.plan: Start Amlodipine 5mg daily for hypertension. Continue Metformin 500mg BD and Atorvastatin 10mg. Order HbA1c, fasting glucose, lipid profile, renal panel. Follow up in 4 weeks.

soap.subjective: Feels generally well. Reports occasional thirst. No chest pain. No dizziness. BP self-monitoring at home shows improvement.
soap.objective: Vitals stable. BP 126/82 — improved since starting Amlodipine. Foot exam normal. No edema.
soap.assessment: T2DM — consider optimizing diet. Hypertension controlled on Amlodipine.
soap.plan: Continue Metformin, Amlodipine, Atorvastatin. Order HbA1c + fasting glucose + lipid profile. Follow up in 3 months.

soap.subjective: Shortness of breath at night. Wheezing. No fever. Mild chest tightness.
soap.plan: Start bronchodilator. Order CBC + CRP. Review in 48 hours.
